sections.heading: 1. Acceptance of Terms
sections.content: By accessing and using PrismTutor Studio's services, you acknowledge that you have read, understood, and agree to be bound by these Terms of Service. If you do not agree to these terms, please do not use our services.

sections.heading: 2. Description of Services
sections.content: PrismTutor Studio provides online and offline educational services including live classes, recorded lectures, NCERT-aligned study materials, mock tests, and mentoring sessions for CBSE, ICSE, JEE, NEET, and Olympiad preparation. The availability of specific features depends on your subscription plan.

sections.heading: 3. User Accounts
sections.content: You are responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of your account credentials and for all activities that occur under your account. You must notify us immediately of any unauthorized use of your account.

sections.heading: 4. Payment Terms
sections.content: Subscription fees are billed on a monthly or annual basis as selected. All prices are in Indian Rupees (INR) and inclusive of applicable GST. We reserve the right to modify pricing with 30 days notice. Payments are processed securely through Razorpay.

sections.heading: 5. Refund Policy
sections.content: Full refunds are available within 14 days of initial purchase. After 14 days, pro-rated refunds may be issued at our discretion. Refund requests should be submitted through our contact page or by emailing hello@prismtutor.in.

sections.heading: 6. Intellectual Property
sections.content: All course content, materials, recordings, DPPs, and proprietary teaching methods are the intellectual property of PrismTutor Studio. Unauthorized reproduction, sharing on Telegram or other platforms, or distribution is strictly prohibited under the Indian Copyright Act.

sections.heading: 7. Code of Conduct
sections.content: Students and parents are expected to maintain respectful behavior during classes and on our platforms. Harassment, cheating, sharing login credentials, or disruptive behavior may result in account suspension without refund.

sections.heading: 8. Limitation of Liability
sections.content: PrismTutor Studio shall not be liable for any indirect, incidental, or consequential damages arising from the use of our services. Our total liability shall not exceed the amount paid by you in the preceding 12 months. This agreement is governed by the laws of India, with jurisdiction in Bengaluru, Karnataka.

sections.heading: 1. Information We Collect
sections.content: We collect personal information you provide directly (name, email, phone number, Aadhaar for verification where applicable, academic details) and automatically (device info, usage patterns, cookies). We also collect academic performance data to personalize your learning experience.

sections.heading: 2. How We Use Your Information
sections.content: Your information is used to provide and improve our services, personalize learning paths, communicate updates via SMS and WhatsApp, process payments through Razorpay, and analyze usage patterns. We never sell your personal information to third parties.

sections.heading: 3. Data Storage & Security
sections.content: All data is stored on encrypted servers hosted in India in compliance with the Information Technology Act, 2000. We implement regular security audits, access controls, and data backup procedures to protect your information.

sections.heading: 4. Cookies & Tracking
sections.content: We use essential cookies for site functionality and analytics cookies to understand usage patterns. You can manage cookie preferences through your browser settings.

sections.heading: 5. Third-Party Services
sections.content: We use select third-party services including Razorpay for payments, Zoom for video conferencing, and Google Analytics for usage analytics. These partners are bound by strict data protection agreements.

sections.heading: 6. Children's Privacy
sections.content: For students under 13, we require parental or guardian consent before collecting any personal information, in compliance with Indian data protection regulations. Parents can review and request deletion of their child's data at any time.

sections.heading: 7. Your Rights
sections.content: You have the right to access, correct, export, or delete your personal data under Indian data protection laws. You can also opt out of marketing communications via SMS, WhatsApp, and email at any time.

sections.heading: 8. Contact Us
sections.content: For privacy-related inquiries, contact our Data Protection Officer at privacy@prismtutor.in or call +91 80 4567 8901. You may also write to us at No. 42, 3rd Cross, Koramangala 4th Block, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560034.
